subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the same aborted-turn drop policy as prompt-send and replay sanitizers for orphaned tool-use turns?
rationale: The code path is narrow and covered, but the choice between dropping the interrupted assistant turn and synthesizing a placeholder affects how much partial session context survives after provider timeouts.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR as the compaction-side repair, accepting limited context loss for aborted assistant tool-call turns to prevent strict-provider session breakage.

options.title: Require synthetic-result policy
options.body: Ask for a revised PR that preserves the aborted assistant turn with an explicit synthetic result and tests if maintainers prefer context retention over dropping.

options.title: Pause for broader transcript policy
options.body: Hold this PR and resolve the wider missing-result semantics with related session-state issues before changing compaction behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the compaction-side repair, accepting limited context loss for aborted assistant tool-call turns to prevent strict-provider session breakage.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is listed as project owner and appears repeatedly in the compaction and transcript-repair history that defines this policy surface.
